coverage.why: Every accounting area from earnings_versus_cash to cross_document_reconciliation, plus industry_lens, has a finding and a verdict. Every financial section plus dupont and path_to_distress has a reading, and input_manifest.json analysis_stages shows nothing dropped from analysis_accounting or analysis_financial.

calibration.why: Area verdicts track their anomalies: estimates_and_reserves 'Low.' over the tax-release and earnout items, controls 'Adverse.' over the material weakness, and cost_deferral 'Clean on capitalization.' beside the non-GAAP item. The cross-document claim that 'each contradiction makes the quarter look better than its figures support' overreaches for the interest-income item.

valuation_reading.why: calculator.json market.missing and implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth.missing leave no price and no implied growth, and the reading says so ('Nothing here says whether the price sits above, inside or below any value'). It picks operating_margin_year_ten and reinvestment_rate_year_ten by distance from the record, not from a computed sensitivity.
